scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.icons: vite build --mode single && node scripts/icons.mjs && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#F28C28' --splashBackgroundColor '#120f1c'
scripts.qa:shots: vite build --mode single && node scripts/shots.mjs all
scripts.qa:flows: vite build --mode single && node scripts/flows.mjs && node scripts/touch.mjs && node scripts/audio.mjs
